parsed.why: Broad July 2025 ban on birth-sex facilities across all public buildings with a private cause of action — a universal exposure for adult visitors — plus no state nondiscrimination or hate-crime law, rated among the worst divisions for anti-trans legislation.

Facility restriction confined to public schools, no statewide adult bathroom rule; circuit employment protection, 19 municipal ordinances, conversion-therapy ban offset hate-crime exclusion and religious-exemption statute. Above parent: no adult-facing universal exposure documented.

Criminal misdemeanour for trans use of public bathrooms where a minor is present, extended K-12 ban, rescinded X marker, religious healthcare-denial law, no state protections; placed in 'Worst Policies In Effect' tier.

First division to strip gender-identity civil-rights protection, then preempt local ordinances — service denial with no remedy — plus a school rule binding all visitors by birth certificate; graded worst-tier, though no adult public-facility ban documented.

No facility ban, 2013 public-accommodations and employment protection reaching service refusals, hate-crime penalty enhancement, provider-statement marker changes, LGBTQ commission; Low-Risk grade. Sits above parent, held down by unchanged national document and entry regime.
